Name: Sprinting
Author: Onemix
Description:
[size=3]Adds a sprinting mechanic when holding LeftControl (Configurable). Also provides energy regeneration based on your max energy, and optional health regeneration (disabled by default).[/size]

[size=3]Everything in the mod is configurable.[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] is highly recommended to configure while in-game.[/size]

[b][size=3]Installation[/size][/b]
[size=3]Unzip the mod folder inside your Mods folder. To uninstall, delete the folder[/size]

[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[size=3]Online and split-screen multiplayer compatible
Not tested on mobile[/size]
[size=3]Should be compatible with any other mod, just pay attention to the keybinds[/size]
[size=3]Built for SMAPI 4.5.2[/size]

[b][size=3]Configuration[/size][/b]
[size=3]Use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] to configure while in-game, otherwise edit the config.json in the mod folder
Values in parentheses are the default[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][i]SprintingKey [/i](LeftControl): the keybind used to sprint while moving[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]SpeedBoost [/i](2): the value of the speed boost received when sprinting[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]EnergyDrainPerSecond [/i](1.0): the energy consumed per second while sprinting (note that if SkillBased is enabled you will consume more energy than this)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]SkillBased [/i](true): The higher your skills levels, the less energy will be consumed while sprinting, uses the formula  [i]energyDrainPerSecond += 5 - totalLevels/10[/i] to add a flat value to [i]EnergyDrainPerSecond[/i], starting at 5 when level 0 on all skills and 0 when all skills are level 10[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]AllowHorseSprinting[/i] (true): if you can sprint while mounted on a horse[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]MinimumEnergyToSprint [/i](15): the least necessary energy to allow sprinting[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]LowEnergyWarning[/i] (true): if a hud message should appear informing that you are low on energy when sprinting[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]EnergyToWarn[/i] (25): when to trigger the low energy warning, when enabled[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]EnergyRegenRate [/i](1.0): the percentage of your max energy regenerated per second[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]EnergyRegenCooldown[/i] (5): how many seconds you need to start regenerating energy since it was last consumed[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]HealthRegenRate[/i] (0.0): the percentage of your max health regenerated per second[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i]HealthRegenCooldown [/i](5): how many seconds you need to start regenerating health since the last hit[/size][/*]
[/list]
